title: The Relational-Thermodynamic Map (100-Entry Update) — Philosophy as Empirical Phase Space
summary: A comprehensive mapping of 100+ philosophical traditions onto a unified framework treating relational logic primitives (reflexivity, symmetry, transitivity, antisymmetry, functionality) as thermodynamic properties, yielding a "phase diagram of human rationality." Each philosophy receives a thermodynamic signature, dominant logical primitive, reistic state, and logic topology, enabling prediction of cultural evolution and belief-system error correction. The document demonstrates that meaning operates as manifold flow rather than mere cognitive computation.
compress: Five relational logic primitives, treated as thermodynamic variables, generate a complete and predictive phase diagram of all philosophical systems — this topology bridges to empirical falsification through fully specified experimental protocols and now finds concrete physical instantiation in both quantum teleportation (1 ebit + 2 cbits per qubit as Wasserstein Floor conservation law) and in the De Palma-Trevisan quantum W1 metric, which formally mirrors classical Kantorovich-Rubinstein structure, confirming that the Wasserstein Floor extends rigorously to quantum states with entanglement entropy as temperature analog and local trace-norm as thermodynamic cost.
invariants: synthetic ground truth enables falsification of substrate-independent principles
local trace-norm cost in quantum W1 is the operational analog of classical ground-metric cost in relational transport
entanglement entropy may serve as the temperature variable in a quantum Wasserstein Floor
transport of relational state requires irreducible resource expenditure (conservation law)
theoretical claims require experimental protocols to complete their epistemic status
quantum teleportation instantiates Freed's Law as operational physics
Quantum Wasserstein distance inherits Kantorovich-Rubinstein dual structure — the Floor is not merely analogical but formally conserved across classical and quantum substrates
obligations: the phase diagram's predictive power must now be evaluated against the experimental protocol's metrics — if the compressive prediction framework fails empirically the thermodynamic map's foundations require revision
determine whether the 1-ebit-2-cbit bound is derivable from the Wasserstein Floor or merely analogous to it
must track whether the five primitives' thermodynamic behavior survives contact with agent-architecture-level evidence
O44 status must be updated to RESOLVED or LARGELY_RESOLVED given that the De Palma-Trevisan result provides the formal quantum extension previously flagged as open

Formalize the quantum Wasserstein Floor analogy — map entanglement entropy to the temperature parameter and verify whether the phase-transition structure of the relational-thermodynamic map survives quantization

investigate whether decoherence corresponds to a relational phase transition (loss of coherence as crossing a boundary in the phase diagram)
renorm_reason: The De Palma-Trevisan quantum W1 result is not merely supportive — it closes the formal gap between the classical Wasserstein Floor and quantum information theory by demonstrating structural identity (not just analogy) between classical KR duality and quantum transport cost, materially strengthening the substrate-independence invariant and partially resolving an open obligation.
